hints.title: Wildcard Any-Sequence Match Obstacle
hints.text: Pattern characters '?' match any single character, while '*' can match any sequence of characters including an empty sequence. How can checking prefix matches between string and pattern verify full wildcard compatibility?

hints.title: Asterisk Branching Invariant
hints.text: When p[j - 1] == '*', it matches an empty sequence (left cell dp[j - 1]) or one/more characters (above cell dp[j]). When p[j - 1] matches s[i - 1] or '?', it inherits from the top-left diagonal.

hints.title: 1D Boolean Rolling Pattern Scan Procedure
hints.text: Initialize a 1D boolean array of size len(p) + 1 for base empty string matches. For each character in s, maintain diagonal value. For each pattern character: if '*' set cell to current or preceding; if match or '?' set cell to diagonal; else set false. Return entry len(p).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Iterates through M x N states using a 1D boolean buffer of size N + 1.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive branching on '*' leads to exponential worst-case runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Compresses 2D matching matrix to 1D row buffer.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly handling leading '*' patterns matching empty strings.
